description: Returns an array of all logs matching filter with given id.

result.description: An array of log objects, or an empty array if nothing has changed since last poll

result.address.description: The address from which this log originated

result.topics.description: An array of (0 to 4) 32 Bytes DATA of indexed log arguments. (In solidity: The first topic is the hash of the signature of the event (e.g. Deposit(address,bytes32,uint256)), except you declared the event with the anonymous specifier)

result.data.description: It contains one or more 32 Bytes non-indexed arguments of the log

result.blockNumber.description: The block number where this log was in. null when its pending. Null when it's a pending log

result.transactionHash.description: The hash of the transaction from which this log was created from. null if the log is pending

result.transactionIndex.description: The integer of the transaction's index position that the log was created from. Null when it's a pending log

result.blockHash.description: The hash of the block where this log was in. Null when it's a pending log

result.logIndex.description: The integer of the log index position in the block. Null when it's a pending log

result.removed.description: It is true if log was removed, due to a chain reorganization and false if it's a valid log
